briefdescription.para: Create InstrProfSymtab from an object file section which contains function PGO names.

detaileddescription.para: When section may contain raw string data or string data in compressed form. This method only initialize the symtab with reference to the data and the section base address. The decompression will be delayed until before it is used. See also create(StringRef) method.

briefdescription.para: NameStrings is a string composed of one of more sub-strings encoded in the format described in collectPGOFuncNameStrings.

detaileddescription.para: This method is a wrapper to readAndDecodeStrings method.

briefdescription.para: Initialize symtab states with function names and vtable names.

detaileddescription.para: FuncNameStrings is a string composed of one or more encoded function name strings, and VTableNameStrings composes of one or more encoded vtable names. This interface is solely used by raw profile reader.

briefdescription.para: Initialize 'this' with the set of vtable names encoded in CompressedVTableNames.
This interface is used by reader of CoverageMapping test format.
A wrapper interface to populate the PGO symtab with functions decls from module M.

detaileddescription.para: This interface is used by transformation passes such as indirect function call promotion. Variable InLTO indicates if this is called from LTO optimization passes. A canonical name, removing non-__uniq suffixes, is added if AddCanonical is true.

briefdescription.para: Create InstrProfSymtab from a set of names iteratable from IterRange.

detaileddescription.para: This interface is used by IndexedProfReader.

briefdescription.para: Create InstrProfSymtab from a set of function names and vtable names iteratable from IterRange.

detaileddescription.para: This interface is used by IndexedProfReader.

briefdescription.para: The method name is kept since there are many callers.
Adds VTableName as a known symbol, and inserts it to a map that tracks all vtable names.
Map a function address to its name's MD5 hash.

detaileddescription.para: This interface is only used by the raw profiler reader.

briefdescription.para: Map the address range (i.e., [start_address, end_address)) of a variable to its names' MD5 hash.

detaileddescription.para: This interface is only used by the raw profile reader.

briefdescription.para: Return a function's hash, or 0, if the function isn't in this SymTab.
Return a vtable's hash, or 0 if the vtable doesn't exist in this SymTab.
Return function's PGO name from the function name's symbol address in the object file.

detaileddescription.para: If an error occurs, return an empty string.

briefdescription.para: Return name of functions or global variables from the name's md5 hash value.

detaileddescription.para: If not found, return an empty string.

briefdescription.para: Just like getFuncOrVarName, except that it will return literal string 'External Symbol' if the function or global variable is external to this symbol table.
Return function from the name's md5 hash. Return nullptr if not found.
Return the global variable corresponding to md5 hash.
Return the name section data.
Dump the symbols in this table.
True if Symbol is the value used to represent external symbols.
A symbol table used for function [IR]PGO name look-up with keys (such as pointers, md5hash values) to the function.

detaileddescription.para: A function's [IR]PGO name or name's md5hash are used in retrieving the profile data of the function. See getIRPGOFuncName() and getPGOFuncName methods for details how [IR]PGO name is formed.
